narr: Thunderstorms during the afternoon and early evening of April 15 produced locally heavy rain in eastern Pennsylvania. Rainfall totals were as high as 2.0 to 3.5 inches.
ev: Several roads in Fountain Hill became impassable due to flooding.
PA Route 309 was closed due to flooding in Upper Saucon Township from Huckleberry Drive to West Hopewell Road.
Several roads in Lower Macungie Township became impassable due to flooding. There was a water rescue from a stranded vehicle at Church Lane and Oak Drive.
lsr: US ROUTE 309 IS CLOSED AT HUCKLEBERRY DRIVE.
WATER RESCUE AT CHURCH LANE AND OAK DRIVE IN TREXLERTOWN.
REPORT FROM MPING: STREET/ROAD FLOODING; STREET/ROAD CLOSED; VEHICLES STRANDED.
